item.title: Fast Models, Slow Evidence: A Paired and Self-Audited Evaluation of System-1 Decision Models for LLM Agent Harnesses
item.description:
The study evaluates quick, single-pass decision models (System‑1) that decide which LLM or tool to use in an agent harness, aiming to cut cost and latency. Researchers tested an open‑weight model and a hosted model on over 7,000 cases, showing how reliable decisions can replace slower, multi‑step checks. The results suggest significant efficiency gains for LLM‑driven workflows, but the work is mainly about model design rather than cloud infrastructure.

IT Breakdown: Not directly applicable to IT infrastructure work

item.title: [News] Forecasting space weather risks on power grids
item.description: Microsoft Research has released a machine‑learning model that forecasts space‑weather events capable of damaging power grids and disrupting GPS and satellite services 30‑60 minutes before they hit. The system could enable utilities and critical infrastructure operators to pre‑emptively protect sensitive equipment and maintain service continuity.

item.title: [News] Introducing SynthID Bio
item.description: Google DeepMind has unveiled SynthID Bio, a proof‑of‑concept system that embeds watermarks into AI‑generated protein sequences without compromising their biological activity. The technology demonstrates how AI can be auditable even in highly specialized scientific domains.

item.title: [News] Gemini 4 Argon: our next era of frontier intelligence
item.description: Google DeepMind has announced Gemini 4 Argon, a new frontier‑intelligence model that expands the capabilities of the Gemini family. While the release is mainly a research milestone, it signals future enhancements that could eventually reach Google Workspace and other enterprise products.

item.title: [News] Turn Energy Efficiency Into Strategic Advantage
[News] New Microsoft data innovations unlock what only your business knows
item.description: Microsoft has announced new data‑centric AI innovations that allow organizations to leverage unique, internal business knowledge for smarter decision‑making. These features extend the capabilities of Azure and Microsoft 365, enabling deeper integration of proprietary data with generative models.
